verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique immigration law firm that provides attorney-led visa and green card services, not a software product or platform. A downloadable machine-readable API spec is a category error for this kind of business. The OpenAPI probe returning 404 on every candidate path only confirms that no such artifact exists, and nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
